minecraft-design `roof()` (tools/src/roofs.mjs, commit) calls `g.resize(..., shift)` when a roof entry has a negative coordinate, moving all existing cells. In the McMansion (runs/build-1/mcmansion-sonnet-high) R3 garage roof had `overhang.west: 1` on a footprint starting at x=0, so the whole shell moved +1 in x; grid grew 44 -> 46; later parts still wrote absolute coords, so the x=19 office wall and x=12 garage wall ended up one column off. Walk then reported 5 rooms unreachable.

**Why:** the plan's "overhang 1 on every side" is impossible at the site edge; the tool silently shifts instead of refusing.

**How to apply:** when a roof footprint touches x=0 or z=0, set that side's overhang to 0. Verify with a grid-size check after the roofs part (`size` must stay SIZE). Bisect with a per-part replay (run each part with runParts, print one cell) to find the part that changes a cell.

Related: [[wall-construct-needs-dense-shell]] (also about walls being built on wrong footprints).

Identity: an 1880s SF Italianate row house: a tall narrow teal false front over a dark-teal garage base, a full-height angled bay on the

frieze under a deep bracketed cream cornice and a pedimented false front hiding a low slate gable. Neighbours press in on both sides
(ochre downhill west, pale blue uphill east). Behind: a lightwell, a kitchen deck and a long garden with a citrus tree and a veg bed.
Lot x0..15, z0..49, y0..20. Front = NORTH (z0 sidewalk). Ground surface y0 (stand y1). All ranges inclusive.

# Plan: San Francisco Italianate painted lady "sfvictorian-opus"

Identity: an 1880s SF Italianate row house: a tall narrow teal false front over a dark-teal garage base, a full-height angled bay on the
west half, a cream stair climbing beside it to a recessed columned porch on the east, gold fish-scale bands between storeys, a burgundy
frieze under a deep bracketed cream cornice and a pedimented false front hiding a low slate gable. Neighbours press in on both sides
(ochre downhill west, pale blue uphill east). Behind: a lightwell, a kitchen deck and a long garden with a citrus tree and a veg bed.
Lot x0..15, z0..49, y0..20. Front = NORTH (z0 sidewalk). Ground surface y0 (stand y1). All ranges inclusive.
LEVELS: base floor y0, base air y1..3 | slab y4, main air y5..7 | slab y8, 2nd air y9..11 | slab y12, top air y13..15 (NO ceiling: open
into the roof) | wall plate/frieze y16 | roof from y17 | false front y17..19, pediment y20.
